base: black canvas with an alizarin crimson and phthalo blue wash

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: light white over the purple base
steps.load: white on the large brush
steps.motion: lay thin color across the sky

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: floater clouds with fan brush
steps.load: load fan full of white
steps.motion: drop in small floaters with the corner

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: blend cloud edges
steps.load: clean dry big brush
steps.motion: gently blend across the clouds
steps.rule: firm dry first coat blends without turning muddy

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: block in distant foothill
steps.load: mix blue and green then add white and brown
steps.motion: basic foothill shape from the corner
steps.rule: brown dulls a mix that is too bright

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: pull brush down for highlights and shadows
steps.load: same large brush
steps.motion: pull down in strokes
steps.rule: changing brush direction makes highlights and shadows

steps.subject: mist
steps.action: tap little white for mist
steps.load: tiny bit of white on the brush
steps.motion: tap in lightly then lift upward
steps.rule: color shows much stronger on black so use little

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: darker second range of hills
steps.load: mix blue and brown on the fan
steps.motion: lay in a little hill shape
steps.where: in front of the first hills
steps.rule: closer things get darker in value

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: red-brown tint on a far hill
steps.load: mix red and burnt umber on the brush
steps.motion: dab color onto the hill

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: soften the red-brown hill
steps.load: clean big brush
steps.motion: gently tap to soften
steps.rule: too far away for bright color

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: tiny bush and tree hints in red
steps.load: add a little white to the same brush
steps.motion: dab small bush and tree marks

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: block in dark green bush line
steps.load: mix sap green and cadmium yellow
steps.motion: block in tree line bottoms
steps.where: lower edge of the tree line

steps.subject: land
steps.action: light meadow band
steps.load: add more cadmium yellow
steps.motion: lay a brighter band across

steps.subject: land
steps.action: new plane in yellow ochre and indian yellow
steps.load: add yellow ochre and indian yellow
steps.motion: lay a new plane over the meadow
steps.rule: a color change makes another plane

steps.subject: land
steps.action: tap to darken the meadow
steps.load: same brush with no new paint
steps.motion: tap to pick up the color underneath
steps.rule: tapping picks up the color underneath to darken

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: big leafy tree mass on the side
steps.load: mix brown crimson and green on brush
steps.motion: pull in one direction then touch and push
steps.rule: a lot of paint avoids hitting the canvas too hard

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: highlight big tree with yellow and green
steps.load: load bristles with yellow and sap green
steps.motion: touch barely and bend bristles
steps.where: upper part of the big tree

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: vary tree clump with yellow ochre and red
steps.load: add yellow ochre then permanent red
steps.motion: same light touch in the clump

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: bright shiny bush on the other side
steps.load: add green then yellow ochre
steps.motion: touch in the bush shape
steps.where: other side of canvas, big old tree

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: red accent on one tree
steps.load: add permanent red to the brush
steps.motion: touch on one tree
steps.rule: to make it stand out a little

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: thin limbs and sticks
steps.load: thin brown with paint thinner and sharpen tip
steps.motion: pull thin limbs out from the top
steps.rule: limbs are pretty so do not leave them out

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: more limbs with white over brown
steps.load: add a little white to the brown on the liner
steps.motion: add more limbs and sticks

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: brown limbs on the other side
steps.load: back to brown on the liner
steps.motion: add limbs here and there

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: more limbs from leftover brown and white
steps.load: thin with paint thinner and add white
steps.motion: add a few more limbs
steps.rule: skipping the brush cleaning saves time

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: tap grassy bits in green yellow and red
steps.load: use the old background mix on the brush
steps.motion: tap small grassy areas up the hill

steps.subject: land
steps.action: dirt patch with brown and umber on knife
steps.load: mix brown and umber on the knife
steps.motion: touch and let the knife bounce
steps.rule: knife work cleans the bottom of the grass

steps.subject: land
steps.action: light gray graze across top of land
steps.load: mix white blue and brown into gray on knife
steps.motion: barely touch across the top

steps.subject: water line
steps.action: pull knife waterlines
steps.load: mix white with a little blue on the knife
steps.motion: pull knife out flat then cut across
steps.where: lower water area under the land
steps.rule: crooked lines would make the water run out

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: add twigs to break up the trees
steps.load: same knife with no new paint
steps.motion: add a few twigs here and there

steps.subject: other: signature
steps.action: sign the painting with thinned paint
steps.load: thin paint with paint thinner
steps.motion: drop a small signature in place

rules: [15:47] keep some dark areas so the tree does not look flat
